subtopics.title: Turnaround Times & Delivery

information.title: Photo Delivery Timeline
information.shortDescription: Standard turnaround is 10 business days for portraits and 3-4 weeks for weddings.
information.detailedContent: Portraits are ready in an online preview proofing gallery within 5 days. Once you select your favorite images for retouching, final high-resolution files are delivered within 5 additional business days. Weddings include sneak-peek photos within 48 hours and complete gallery delivery within 3-4 weeks.

policy.policyText: A non-refundable 25% deposit secures your date. In the event of illness or severe weather for outdoor sessions, clients may reschedule once with at least 48 hours notice without incurring a rebooking fee.

knowledge.title: Studio Location & Hours
knowledge.content: The studio is located at 440 Artisan Way, Suite 200. Open Tuesday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM by appointment only. Free dedicated parking is available in the rear lot.

knowledge.title: What to Wear to a Portrait Session
knowledge.content: We recommend solid neutral or jewel-toned colors. Avoid small repetitive stripes, neon colors, and prominent logos. Bring 2 to 3 outfit options so the photographer can help select what photographs best with our backdrop setup.

knowledge.title: Payment Terms & Methods
knowledge.content: We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, bank ACH transfers, and Apple Pay. 25% due upon booking, remaining 75% due 48 hours before the shoot date.

knowledge.title: Hours of Operation
knowledge.content: Lunch: Tuesday - Sunday, 11:30 AM to 2:30 PM. Dinner: Sunday - Thursday, 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM; Friday & Saturday, 5:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Closed Mondays.

knowledge.title: Valet & Parking Information
knowledge.content: Complimentary valet parking is available at our main entrance after 5:30 PM on Thursdays through Sundays. Street parking is available along Pine Street.

knowledge.title: Nervous & Anxious Patients Sedation
knowledge.content: We provide gentle conscious IV sedation and nitrous oxide (laughing gas) for nervous patients. A certified dental anesthesiologist monitors your vital signs throughout the treatment.

messages.text: How much is a portrait session?

Our **Signature Portrait Session** starts at **R 500**. 

This 60-minute session includes:
* 1 hour of shooting time
* Up to 2 wardrobe changes
* An online proofing gallery with 40+ proofs
* 5 high-resolution, fully retouched digital files

*(Optional add-on: Hair and makeup styling is available for +R 95.00.)*

Would you like more details or help booking a session?
